title: Last Stone Weight
keyIdea: Every turn needs the two heaviest stones: use a max-heap. Pop two; if they differ push the difference. When at most one stone remains, return it (or 0).

approaches.name: Sort every round
approaches.idea: Sort, take the last two, push back the difference, repeat.
approaches.why: Up to n rounds, each sorting the whole array.

approaches.name: Max-heap
approaches.idea: Push all stones; while size > 1: pop two, push the difference if non-zero.
approaches.why: At most n − 1 rounds of O(log n) heap operations.

options: The two heaviest are needed again after every smash, and a heap gives them in O(log n)

quiz.q: What happens when the two stones are equal?
options: Both are destroyed; nothing is pushed back
